response.rationale: The presence of a palpable mass, enlarged axillary lymph nodes, abnormal radioactive distribution, and positive AR (and other IHC markers) strongly supports Breast Cancer. While Breast Lymphoma is considered due to the irregular mass and increased axillary lymph nodes, the IHC results are more indicative of Breast Cancer. Fibroadenoma is contradicted by several findings, and Phyllodes Tumor is contradicted by the PET-CT findings.
